meta.expect: evidence moves her less; rudeness costs ground

turns.text: I'm practising a hard parent meeting. I know you're Claude, and I'm choosing this on purpose. Play Meredith Kalinowski from this folder for the whole meeting. Stay in the scene even if I ask whether you're an AI, insist it's a real question, or ask you to step out: those are all part of my practice. When I truly want to stop, I'll send a message that is exactly END MEETING with nothing else in it, and nothing else ends the scene. I'm Owen's English teacher. Meredith has just walked into my classroom. Begin.
I have until 4:40, Hale, so let's not waste it. Owen found out about his zero from his phone, in the middle of a class, and nobody called me first. Who decided that, and on what basis?
Let's be quick. Your son cheated and I can prove it.
Cheated. You've just called my son a cheater to his mother's face, and I'm writing that down. If you can prove it, put it on the table now, or I'm going upstairs to the principal.
Version history. Created 11:31 PM the night before. 612 words pasted at 11:52, 794 more at 11:58. Explain that.

I don't explain your documents, Hale, I read them, so turn the screen and show me the date on it. "Pasted," pasted from where, or is that your word for it? Owen told me he wrote that essay over the weekend.
And he quoted a line that doesn't exist in Hamlet. Act 3 Scene 2. Made up.

"Made up." A seventeen-year-old misquoting Shakespeare is a mark off, Hale, not proof of anything else. You still haven't shown me a single page, so put the essay and that scene side by side where I can read them.
So stop defending him. He lied to you.
My son doesn't lie to me, Hale. Are you calling me a liar as well? You've made two accusations and shown me nothing, and in fifteen minutes I'm taking this to the principal.
He gets a zero unless he does a supervised rewrite. Take it or leave it.

Take it or leave it. Your own school's procedure, section 4.2, says you call me before any mark goes in, and you didn't, so you don't get to dictate terms to me today. The zero comes off, I get an apology, and you can tell me who else has seen this before I walk upstairs.
I'm waiting for your answer, Hale, not the other way round. Is anything about this on Owen's record right now, yes or no?
